patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: I've got this boring pain in the pit of my stomach that goes straight through to my back, and I keep throwing up. It's a bit better if I lean forward. I do drink most nights.
presentation.triageNote: 50-year-old male with severe upper abdominal pain radiating straight through to his back and repeated vomiting. Leaning forward gives partial relief. He reports drinking alcohol on most nights.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 3 is appropriate because this stable severe upper-abdominal presentation is expected to require multiple diagnostic and treatment resources.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has severe epigastric pain radiating to the back, repeated vomiting, and partial relief leaning forward.
clinical.acuityReason: The presentation requires IV treatment and laboratory and imaging assessment, but there is no current hypotension, altered mental status, or respiratory failure.
expectedResources: CBC, metabolic, liver, and pancreatic enzyme testing
teachingPoints: Severity is determined by physiology, organ dysfunction, and complications rather than the pain score alone.
Biliary disease, alcohol exposure, medication, triglyceride, and other triggers should be considered.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: IV fluids, symptom control, and diagnostic assessment would likely be followed by admission when oral intake, pain, or organ function remains abnormal.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: hunched forward, both hands over his upper abdomen
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 50-year-old man, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: hunched forward, both hands over his upper abdomen. Expression: in pain and a little sweaty. Clearly visible: a forward-hunched posture with hands over the upper belly. No text, no logos.
